page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening). Running head "I K" centred at top, page number 519 at top right. Main text in one column: entries of a Greek-Latin-Hebrew name glossary, beginning with Iωρακμ entries, then section letter K and entries Κ. Left margin of the scan holds a column of marginal notes (partly cut off by the gutter), not transcribed in full.

main_text.p: Ἰωρακμ ὁ nomen regis ἀχλιτον, Hebr. ex Domino excelsus.
Ἰωρειμ ὁ nomen viri, Hebr. Jeorim rivi.
Ἰωσαφατ ὁ nomen pii regis, Hebr. ἀχλιτον, Dominus judicabit.
Ἰωσης ὁ nomen viri ἀχλιτον, senex.
Ἰωσηφ ὁ nomen viri ἀχλιτον, addat.
Ἰωσιας ꝫ ὁ nomen viri, Hebr. qui est a Domino.
main_text.head: K.
main_text.p: Καιάφας α ὁ nomen pontificis, Hebr. q. d. circuitor.
Καιν nomen primi fratricida, Hebr. acquisitus.
Καινὰν ὁ nomen viri ἀχλιτον, Hebr. possessor.
Καισαρ ὁ nomen primi monarcha inter Romanos, Latin. a caedendo.
Καισαρεια ας ἡ nomen urbis, Latin. Caesarea.
Καινὰ ἡ nomen urbis ἀχλιτον, Hebr. possessio.
Καναναιτης ꝫ ὁ nomen viri, Hebr. aemulator, Luc. 6. 15.
Καυδακη ης ἡ nomen commune omnibus Æthiopum reginis. Vox origine Æthiopica.
Καπερναὺμ ἡ nomen urbis, ἀχλιτον, Hebr. pagus vicus consolationis.
Καππαδοκια ας ἡ nomen regionis ab amne Cappadoce.
Καρπὸς ꝫ ὁ nomen viri, Gr. fructus.
Κεγχρεαὶ ων αἱ nomen portus Corinthiaci, Gr. à milio.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are cut off by the gutter and largely illegible; not transcribed. Greek and Hebrew words are transcribed approximately; several Hebrew forms (ἀχλιτον) are doubtful. Left-margin Hebrew and Greek references are not legible enough to copy.
